messages:
viv: Quick q for folks heading to Tokyo next week 1f11f11f0
Anyone bring power banks >20k mAh in carry-on or checked? Worried about airline limits. Also, passport photocopy vs photo on phone?

noah: Power banks must be in carry-on per most airlines. Keep them charged <100%? (jk) :battery:
I carry a 20k and a 10k to be safe.

anya: I snap a photo of passport + email myself a copy. Paper photocopy goes in checked bag, phone copy in secure notes. Worked when my wallet was pickpocketed in Barcelona.

kyle: PSA: tape your passport photocopy inside the front of a guidebook or folder. Helps if bag gets rifled. Also bring a compact battery (<100Wh) in carry-on and declare if asked.

travel-bot: Airline rule: most carriers allow power banks up to 100Wh in carry-on without approval; >100Wh usually needs airline approval. Check your carrier.

viv: Thanks! One more: any preferred compact chargers? USB-C PD 65W single brick recs?

noah: Anker 65W GaN brick. Small and reliable. Bring a short USB-C cable and a multi-outlet adapter for hotels with few plugs.

anya: I have a tiny 65W GaN and a 30W backup. Pack one cable per device; untangling in the hotel is a pain.

kyle: Mini poll 44d44e
Meet for a quick airport coffee at 8:15 near gate 22 before shuttle to hotel?

viv: +1

noah: +1

anya: -1 (arriving later)

travel-bot: Poll created: "Airport coffee 8:15 Gate 22". Current: 2 yes, 1 no.

viv: Perfect, I'll put a note in the meetup thread and bring a spare charging cable for anyone who forgets. See you! :airplane: :coffee:
